name: Beauty Contest
source:
Clara wants to take first place in a Beauty Contest but meets her long-time rival Sherly and childhood friend Olivia. Will Clara be able to win, or will other feelings awaken in her?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1363270/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
克拉拉想在选美比赛中夺得第一，却遇见了多年的对手雪莉，以及儿时好友奥莉维娅。她能赢得比赛，还是心中会萌生别样的感情？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1363270/]Steam[/url]]
